lines.en: It is well known that people remember negative experiences far longer than positive ones.
What worries psychologists is that children are growing up with less face-to-face communication than ever before.
The more we understand our own fears, the less power they have over us.
Not only does stress affect the mind, but it can also weaken the body over time.
However confident someone appears, they may be fighting battles nobody knows about.
It is said that we make most of our decisions emotionally and then justify them with logic.
Were we more honest about our feelings, many misunderstandings would never happen.
What children need most is not expensive toys, but the feeling that they are loved and safe.
Rarely do we realize how much our childhood shapes the adults we become.
It was only after years of anxiety that he finally learned to ask for help.
